description:
The best way to build from references, with or without a person: pass 2 to 6 screen ids from
search_screens (each "id: what to take from it") and get one Markdown brief with the
screenshots attached at 1x (section crops for long pages), measured component sizes, the
page structure and what to take from each. Up to 6 images are attached (one per reference, then
extra section crops); the brief's first line lists them and names a get_screen_image call for
any left out. Structure comes from the screens and every visual
token from one style product, so conflicting looks are resolved instead of mixed. Interactive
parts get matching motion entries to fetch with get_motion. E.g. Linear's issue composer,
Vercel's pricing layout and Notion's look in one screen.

goal.description: What you want to build. Goes at the top of the brief.

screens.description: 1 to 6 screen ids, each optionally followed by ": what to take from it", e.g. ["linear-product-new-issue: issue composer modal", "vercel-marketing-pricing: plan cards and FAQ"].

stack.description: Preferred stack, e.g. Next.js and Tailwind.

style.description: Product id whose measured visual language to use, e.g. linear or stripe. Omit to use the project's own design system.

styleContext.description: Which of the style product's guides to use. Defaults to marketing when most screens are marketing pages, otherwise product.

styleNotes.description: Extra visual direction in words, e.g. "our brand green #1a7f37, rounded corners". Used on its own when style is omitted.

name: build_recipe
title: Build a reference recipe
